name: resume.aiascent.dev Autofill
description: Fills the application form in your own browser with the package you approved in resume.aiascent.dev. You press Submit.
_comment_cookies: C154 (154.1) — the sign-in window: a provider sign-in (Google, LinkedIn, Microsoft) refuses to run inside the panel's frame, so it runs in a window of its own; the session it makes is then carried into the frame's own cookie partition with cookies.set({partitionKey}). Neither browser shows a warning for this permission.
_comment_optional_host_permissions: C143 (143.16) — MEASURED: 1,308 of 8,030 cards sit on an employer's OWN career domain (databricks.com, careers.datadoghq.com, okta.com …) while carrying a Greenhouse gh_jid in the URL. Those are boards the fill engine can already read; only permission was missing. Enumerating them is hopeless (one host per employer), so the panel asks for the single host it is about to fill, at the moment it fills it — the C141 host-access question, widened. Optional means nothing is granted until the user says yes to that host.
_comment_webRequest: C149 (149.2) — the framed-session cookie door: Set-Cookie SameSite=Lax → None; Secure on responses to requests the app frames, so a signed-in wizard keeps its session inside the panel. Firefox MV3 keeps the blocking lane; Chrome MV3 warns and ignores it (the panel keeps the tab door there). C166 — widened from Workday to iCIMS, which signs in once at login.icims.com and carries that session across every tenant: background.js FRAMED_SESSION_URLS.
_comment_scripting: C156 (156.6) — the employer's own careers domain. A host granted at runtime (permission.html) is not a host `content_scripts.matches` covers, so the fill engine has to be registered for it: background.js `syncGrantedHostScripts`. Nothing is registered for a host nobody granted.
